item.title: CLIO autumn releases add Intel GPU support and a data agent
item.description: CLIO components shipped between October 8 and November 13, 2026. The latest versions are Agent 0.9.7, GACT TUI 0.13 and Marketplace 0.8.

item.title: ChronoLog 3.3 to 3.5 add durable writes and a new dependency stack
item.description: Three releases followed 3.2 between October 15 and November 12, 2026. Version 3.3 indexes the HDF5 archive through per-ChronoGrapher manifest logs, and 3.4 adds opt-in durable writes that return only after the event is on disk in ChronoKeeper's write-ahead log. Version 3.5 moves to Spack 1.2.2, Mercury 2.4.1 and Margo 0.24.4, so all servers and clients must upgrade together.
